jobs.jobDescription:
Overview

Smartling is an AI-native translation platform that's redefining how the world's biggest brands go global — ranked #3 on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list. We're growing rapidly at scale and are backed by Battery Ventures, a global technology-focused investment firm. While most companies are still figuring out how to use AI, we've spent years building it into the core of our platform — and we're just getting started.

Smartling is seeking a talented, motivated and tech-savvy Solution Consultant (Sales Engineer) based in the Pacific time zone. This person would work as part of the Sales team to surpass our revenue goals by driving the successful adoption of Smartling solutions while building great customer relationships. In addition, the Solution Consultant would contribute to tools and process improvements, as well as play a key role in account management and overall customer satisfaction and growth.

You Will

  • Support Enterprise and Mid-Market Sales representatives to meet revenue goals
  • Create custom demonstrations based on customer needs
  • Demonstrate Smartling solutions
  • Manage pilot implementations with proven project management skills
  • Work with internal resources to solve customer issues
  • Build and sustain great customer relationships
  • Work with clients to identify business needs beyond the initial pilot phase
  • Provide customer support as needed
  • Develop new tools and process improvements
  • Contribute new feature requests and be a conduit for customer feedback

You Have

  • 3+ years of technical sales within a SaaS or internet technology company
  • Comfortable with website technology, such as HTML/CSS, XML, JavaScript, etc
  • Proficient with CMS systems and website creation
  • Experience with databases and RESTful API integrations
  • Relevant work with SaaS/Hosted Solutions strongly preferred
  • Experience with mobile application development is a plus
  • Practiced Solution Selling or equivalent

You Will Enjoy

  • Freedom 🏡 - we are remote-first
  • Growth - an opportunity to learn and advance your career
  • Wealth 💰 - we offer a competitive salary and 401(k) + company match
  • Wellness - health insurance; free medical plan for you and your family
  • Balance - flexible PTO + 11 holidays; generous parental leave
  • Culture 🤝- an energetic, value-driven, and fun culture and team spirit
  • Bonus - employee referral program and Apple equipment

We are only considering candidates based in the PT zone, as there will be occasional travel to local clients.

Smartling is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, skills, and experiences.

We use E-verify platform for work authorization verification.

*To work from home, you must have a strong internet connection, a quiet space, and a professional (distraction- and clutter-free) background.

The US national target pay range for this role is $170,000-$200,000, including variable component. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including geographic location as well as candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from amounts listed.

jobs.jobDescription:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Role Summary

The AVP, Suitability Review, leads the team responsible for evaluating and supporting suitability decisions across ESI. This highly visible role brings together sound judgment, regulatory discipline, operational leadership, and people development to ensure suitability reviews are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable requirements.

Success in this role requires building a highly capable and engaged team that demonstrates critical problem solving/prevention in suitability review. The leader ensures that all work is processed timely, accurately and in accordance with applicable rules, regulations and Company requirements. Additionally, the leader ensures that stakeholders are kept pro-actively informed during the process and that decisions are communicated in an effective manner. This leader will cultivate a culture of continuous learning and process improvement and will inspire the department to expand their teams’ capabilities. The successful candidate will empower their leaders and associates and build trust with them to deliver on the promise our company represents. This role will report to the Senior Vice President, ESI Operations.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Provide vision, strategic planning insight and thoughtful solutioning expertise for the enterprise and functional group in a collaborative and positively differentiating way
  • Support the development of direct reports by fostering and supporting career development, motivating, engaging and capitalizing on employee strengths
  • Oversee the ESI Suitability Review unit, including responsibility for ensuring the firm’s Written Supervisory Procedures are followed regarding the review and acceptance of new accounts and daily transactions.
  • Build cross-functional partnerships with other business units and teams throughout the organization, including Distribution, Compliance, Legal, Technology, CIG, ESI New Business, ESI Brokerage, to deliver on business results and manage risk.
  • Establish a highly effective and highly engaged team, with positive morale
  • Work in partnership with members of ESI senior leadership team to ensure priorities are clear and are in line with business strategies
  • Provides direction on issue resolution and coaches on complex decisions with a bias towards root cause analysis
  • Prioritize, manage and oversee technology and other projects to improve departmental efficiency. Work closely with technology and service vendors to ensure requirements and service standards and are met.
  • Direct the amendment and creation of ESI forms related to new business and ongoing transactions, necessary to demonstrate compliance with rules, regulations and Company policies.
  • Serve as a point of escalation for jumbo cases, complex suitability issues and field conflict situations. Serve as back-up for the review and principal approval of new accounts and transactions, as necessary.
  • Work closely with internal and external auditors to provide requested documentation and support as requested.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 10+ years of industry experience in Suitability and Broker-Dealer Operations.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions.

You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization
  • Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics
  • Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly
  • Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests
  • Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource
  • Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions
  • Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences
  • Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions
  • Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data
  • Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments
  • Experience in a high-growth environment
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred)
  • Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust.

Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day.

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Performance Task — 60 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation 💰

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
Start your sales career where the world’s live experiences begin

Concerts, festivals, workshops, fundraisers, food crawls, comedy nights: people come together through events, and Eventbrite powers millions of them. We’re looking for a curious, driven, team-first person to be the first voice of Eventbrite for businesses and organizers, opening doors and building the pipeline that fuels Eventbrite.

This is a launchpad role. No prior sales experience is required. We’ll teach you the craft, and you bring the energy.

What you’ll do

  • Be the spark for our sales team. Join a fast-moving B2B sales team and help us scale. You’ll run and sharpen our outreach process, build relationships, and see your impact in real numbers.
  • Hunt for great opportunities. Research and reach out to promising creators through calls, email, and social, and build a pipeline of companies that could grow with Eventbrite.
  • Become an industry insider. Learn what motivates event organizers and decision-makers, what keeps them up at night, and how Eventbrite can help.
  • Know the product, and shape it. Learn to talk about our platform with clarity and confidence, and bring what you hear from customers back to our product teams.
  • Let the data guide you. Track your performance, spot patterns, and focus on the opportunities with the biggest payoff.
  • Make every interaction count. Earn trust with every call, email, and conversation.

What you’ll gain

  • Real training and a clear path forward. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. If you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects.
  • A front-row seat to a high-performing sales org. Learn from experienced reps and leaders in small, collaborative teams.
  • Meaningful work from day one. Your outreach directly feeds revenue, and you’ll have room to take initiative and be recognized for it.
  • Competitive pay. For early-career hires, base salary typically ranges from $70,173 to $91,661 in the US, plus performance-based variable compensation. Pay varies by location and expected impact, and grows as you do. For exceptional candidates, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact.
  • Flexibility. This role is fully remote.

Who we’re looking for

You don’t need a perfect résumé. We care about who you are and how you work:

  • Drive. You’re motivated, take ownership, and keep raising your own bar.
  • Curiosity and problem-solving. You ask good questions, learn quickly, and can break down a tough problem into clear next steps.
  • Team spirit. You share ideas and credit, jump in to help, and communicate honestly.
  • Resilience. You can hear “not right now,” learn from it, and keep going.
  • Strong communication. You can pick up the phone, start a conversation with a stranger, and make it worthwhile for both sides

Bonus points

Experience like this shows the traits that make great SDRs:

  • Event planning or a love of live events, from running one to simply never missing a show
  • Founding or running a business, side hustle, or student venture
  • Leadership or active involvement in student associations, clubs, Greek life, or volunteer organizations
  • Participation in academic or case competitions, hackathons, or pitch contests
  • Strong academic achievement, such as honors, scholarships, or a high GPA
  • Customer-facing work like retail, hospitality, campus roles, or internships

Our hiring process

If your application is a fit, you’ll have a couple of conversations with our team. We’ll explore your motivation, goals, and how you approach unfamiliar challenges. Interviews are a two-way conversation: a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to learn more about the company. So make the most of it; ask questions, dig into the way we work, and hear directly from the people you’re going to meet.
We set the bar high and won't extend an offer until we're convinced we've found the right candidate. This is why a job may stay open for months or be reposted several times.

ABOUT EVENTBRITE

At Eventbrite everyone is invited to be their whole self and we cultivate an environment to make sure that is feasible throughout the entirety of an individual's time at Eventbrite. We are committed to providing competitive, valuable and meaningful benefits and experiences for our employees to ensure we meet them where they are in life.

Cultivating a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where all people are invited and belong is our top priority.

Employees can participate in resource groups and we offer global programming and training throughout the year to support a diverse and inclusive workplace. Read more about our Diversity and Inclusion work for our team, culture, and community.

BENEFITS

We offer comprehensive benefits and a wellness package above and beyond standard medical benefits to support our Britelings’ lifestyle.

Eventbrite's global benefit programs are designed to meet you where you are by offering resources and support for your health, well-being, finances, and family. This includes support in a remote environment, wellness allowance, Carrot family planning benefit, Origin Financial Planning service, and other offerings to ease the mind and body like Modern Health and BriteBreaks (generally the first Friday of every month off).

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

At Eventbrite, we are dedicated to fostering diversity, equity and inclusion. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities and experiences to apply, and we make employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender reassignment, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics, or any other legally protected characteristic.

If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.jobDescription:
Documo is on a mission to help businesses digitize and streamline their document workflows. As a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, our platform makes it easier to handle unstructured files like faxes and forms through tools like Intelligent Document Processing - turning messy paperwork into structured, usable data. We believe great products start with great people. That’s why we invest in top talent, value strong culture, and prioritize customer success and design excellence.

If you’re excited to do impactful work and want to grow with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and purpose - we’d love to meet you!

About Documo

Documo helps healthcare organizations turn information into action. Referrals, records, and authorizations still arrive as faxes and forms, and someone has to read, sort, and key in every page. We automate that manual document work. Our platform combines HIPAA-compliant cloud fax, Direct Secure Messaging, and AI-powered document and workflow automation, so critical work moves faster and care teams get time back for patients.

We’re a small team, so everyone has real ownership and can see the impact of their work. We hire people who care about customers, sweat the details, and want to build something that matters in healthcare. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

The role

This is a pipeline generation role. You will decide who we target, when, why and with what message, then run integrated campaigns that carry that plan across our channels. Those channels include BDR outreach, events, LinkedIn and social, partner marketing, marketplaces, review sites, email, the website and paid media.

The job is campaign strategy and execution, not just channel management. You will need enough digital skill to work hands-on across web, email, social and paid, and you will help manage our paid media agency. You will work daily with the BDR team and sales, and with content, product marketing and SEO. Your ultimate KPI is pipeline.

What you'll own

Integrated and account-based campaigns

  • Own the integrated campaign calendar: one theme and offer per campaign, sequenced across outbound, website, events, email, LinkedIn, paid media (with our agency) and content.
  • Build and run our ABM program with sales: target account list, tiers (1:1 for top enterprise accounts, 1:few clusters by EHR or segment, 1:many for the broader ICP), and a play for each tier.
  • Launch a go-to-market campaign for each new EHR integration: buy and enrich lists of that EHR's customers, target the right ICP titles and specialties, and brief content on EHR-specific messaging and assets.
  • Build automated sales enablement that gives BDRs and AEs timely reasons to reach out to prospects and open opportunities, such as intent signals, EHR and technology fit, hiring, funding and event attendance.
  • Brief content, product marketing and web on the assets and landing pages each campaign needs.
  • Track engagement and pipeline at the account and buying-group level, not just leads.

BDR programs and outbound campaigns

  • Be marketing's partner to the BDR manager: you build the lists and messaging, they run the team and the daily outreach. You work side by side on what each segment needs.
  • Build target segments by ICP, EHR, specialty, organization size and buying trigger, with sales and the BDR manager.
  • Source, enrich and maintain prospect lists using Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, enrichment tools and intent data; keep data clean and routed.
  • Write messaging and multi-touch sequences (email, phone, LinkedIn) for each segment with the BDR manager; test, measure and retire what doesn't book meetings.
  • Run campaign sprints with the BDRs: account lists, talk tracks, offers and event follow-up plays.
  • Report weekly on meetings booked, meeting-to-opportunity conversion and pipeline by segment.

Inbound lead programs

  • Work with the website manager on campaign offers and CTAs, so each campaign's landing experience matches its segment and message.
  • Run nurture for leads that aren't ready to buy, and track MQL-to-SQL-to-pipeline conversion with sales.

Events

  • Own pipeline generation for every event on our calendar: industry shows such as HIMSS, EHR and partner events such as PointClickCare, and category events. Event selection, logistics and booth setup are run by our Content Marketing Manager.
  • Before the show: build target attendee and account lists, and run pre-event outreach with the BDRs to book meetings.
  • At the show: staff the booth, run booked meetings and capture leads (roughly 25% travel).
  • After the show: run follow-up sequences with the BDRs within days, and track meetings and opportunities to close.
  • Report meetings, pipeline and cost per meeting for each event, and recommend which events to keep, add or drop.

Paid media partnership

  • Help manage our paid search and paid social agency: shape campaign ideas, set targeting and offers, and review results against pipeline.
  • Align paid retargeting and ABM audiences with outbound and event target lists.

Reviews, marketplaces, partner marketing and LinkedIn

  • Own our G2 profile and presence on other review sites (Capterra, TrustRadius, KLAS where relevant); keep listings, categories and screenshots current.
  • Run an always-on review program with CS and sales: ask timing, incentives and quarterly targets; use reviews in campaigns and sales materials.
  • Manage marketplace listings with EHR and technology partners and keep them generating leads. Support partner marketing with those partners: co-branded campaigns, joint webinars and partner events, and partner lead follow-up with the BDRs.
  • Use LinkedIn (company page, Sales Navigator, employee and executive posting, events) as a pipeline channel, not just an awareness channel.

How we'll measure success

Pipeline is the measure that matters. Supporting indicators:

  • Marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline against target, by campaign, segment and channel.
  • Engagement, meetings and pipeline in target ABM accounts.
  • Meetings and sales-accepted opportunities from BDR outreach, events and inbound, including MQL-to-SQL conversion.
  • Pipeline per dollar for each event and campaign.
  • Review count, rating and G2 category position, and leads from marketplaces, partners and LinkedIn.

What you bring

  • 4–6 years in B2B SaaS marketing with direct ownership of field/event marketing and outbound or SDR programs.
  • A record of running integrated, multi-channel and account-based campaigns, and of building lists and messaging that measurably increased meetings and pipeline.
  • Hands-on with Salesforce and HubSpot. Required: building and enriching lists with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data or enrichment tools such as Seamless.AI, ZoomInfo, Clay or Apollo.
  • Experience driving pipeline from trade shows: pre-show outreach, booth work and post-show follow-up.
  • A collaborative working style: you will share ownership of outbound with a BDR manager and must work well as a peer. Clear, concise writing for outbound email, LinkedIn and event invites.
  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up research, list work and copy testing.
  • Digital marketing fluency across web, email, social and paid, and comfort reporting on pipeline, not just activity.

Bonus points

  • Healthcare, health IT or EHR-ecosystem experience (HIMSS, EHR user groups, KLAS).
  • Experience running a G2 or review program.
  • Experience with partner or app marketplaces.

The annual base salary range for this remote, US-based role is $100,000.00 to $120,000.00 USD. Actual compensation within this range will depend on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications, with consideration for internal equity.

In addition to base salary, this role offers bonus potential and benefits.

Why join Documo?

  • Competitive U.S. benefits: medical, dental, vision, and a 401(k) with a strong match.

  • Annual bonus program based on role and company performance.

  • Annual performance reviews with merit increases.

  • In-person company kick-off to connect, collaborate, and celebrate.

  • Equity opportunities to grow with us.

  • Flexible remote work that fits your life, plus flexible paid time off.

  • Competitive paid parental leave, mental health support, and Employee Assistance Programs (EAP).

  • Be part of a small, fast-growing tech company with a supportive, inclusive, and fun culture.

We celebrate differences.
Documo welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, especially those underrepresented in tech. We do not discriminate based on ancestry, race, place of origin, political belief, religion, marital or family status, physical or mental ability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. Documo is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.jobDescription:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

We're looking for a technically rigorous and commercially savvy Senior Actuary, Outcomes to bring actuarial depth to Maven's Clinical Outcomes team. This role spans actuarial modeling, healthcare claims analytics, and client-facing strategy—supporting our Growth and Product functions with projections, retrospective analyses, and value-based care modeling. The ideal candidate brings formal actuarial training or equivalent experience, thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, and can credibly represent Maven's methodology with brokers, consultants, and employer clients.

As a Senior Actuary, Outcomes at Maven, you will:

  • Own claims and savings projections and retrospective analyses across Maven's employer benefit programs—including performance guarantee assessments, value-based care arrangement modeling, and spend and enrollment projections across Maven's full program portfolio
  • Build, maintain, and scale Maven's actuarial and ROI models in Excel, ensuring methodological rigor and integrating models into team workflows for self-service use
  • Conduct actuarial confidence evaluations to inform revenue recognition decisions and assess financial risk in value-based arrangements
  • Support RFP responses with actuarial projections, benchmarking, and methodology documentation
  • Perform detailed claims analytics for individual and pooled client populations, including evaluation of performance guarantees based on claims data evaluations
  • Join sales and client success calls—including with brokers and benefits consultants—to speak with authority on outcomes methodology, ROI, and actuarial assumptions
  • Contribute to thought leadership through white papers, research publications, industry conferences, and partner with Marketing to reach actuarial and benefits audiences
  • Manage external actuarial vendor relationships, serving as owner and subject matter expert on scoping and quality of deliverables

We're looking for you to bring:

  • An FSA, ASA, or equivalent actuarial credential (or meaningful progress toward credentialing), or a graduate degree with 6+ years of directly relevant actuarial or healthcare analytics experience
  • Strong analysis design, modeling, and data manipulation skills, with the ability to synthesize findings into clear, client-ready outputs
  • Comfort working in both a coding language (SQL preferred) as well as in Excel, and strong ability to use AI to produce and QA code for data exploration and analysis
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting to external audiences (e.g., clients), including experience presenting technical material to non-technical audiences
  • Strong project management instincts with the ability to juggle competing priorities and self-direct in an unstructured environment
  • Deep familiarity with healthcare claims data, including medical and pharmacy claims structures, PMPM/PBPM cost modeling, and trend analysis
  • Passion for improving maternal and family health outcomes through data-driven innovation

Helpful experiences and skills (if you don't have them, you can learn them with us!):

  • Experience in employer-sponsored benefits, stop-loss, or managed care actuarial roles
  • Familiarity with performance guarantee structures and risk-based contracting
  • Experience supporting sales or growth functions in a healthcare technology or benefits company
  • Background in women's health, maternity, or family benefits
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker a plus)

The base salary range for this role is $180,000-$210,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
